core_obligations: Write down the formula for lambda on monomials in terms of the given elements m_{s_i} (proof lines 2653-2658).
Extend by A-linearity to obtain a biderivation and conclude uniqueness (proof lines 2659-2659).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a polynomial ring P = A[S] and a (P,P)-bimodule M over A, given elements m_s in M for s in S there exists a unique A-biderivation lambda : P -> M mapping s to m_s (source lines 2646-2651). The proof gives the explicit formula for lambda on monomials as the sum over the positions of the inserted elements m_{s_i}, and observes that extending by A-linearity produces a biderivation, which also gives uniqueness since the values on monomials are forced.
